detail.longDescription: I have created two functions that yield expressions, each function works in with_columns individually, but when put together fails. Is there a way to run these within the same with_columns, or am I forced to use pipe? def clip_columns(args: list[tuple[str,dict[str,float]]]): """ example input args = [ ('rain',{'lower_bound'=0.0,'upper_bound'=100}), ('hurs',{'lower_bound'=0.0}) ] """ for (col, kwargs) in args: yield pl.col(col).clip(**kwargs).name.keep() def max_across_cols(args: dict[str,tuple[str,str]]): """ example {"max_temp":("min_temp","max_temp")} """ for col_name, arg_cols in args.items(): yield pl.max_horizontal(arg_cols[0], arg_cols[1]).alias(col_name) ## Below Fails df = df.with_columns( clip_columns( [ ('rain', {'lower_bound':0}), ('hursmin', {'lower_bound':0}), ('radn', {'lower_bound':2}) ] ), max_across_cols({"hursmax":("hursmin","hursmax")}) ) ## This works (likewise only clip_columns works) df = df.with_columns( max_across_cols({"hursmax":("hursmin","hursmax")}) ) Error message: return wrap_expr(plr.lit(item, allow_object, is_scalar=True)) ~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ TypeError: cannot create expression literal for value of type generator. Hint: Pass `allow_object=True` to accept any value and create a literal of type Object. Unclear if this is a bug or I'm missing a step.
